## Wider coverage

The Pew Research Center reports on religion and education and on the global
gender gap in religion were covered by the New York Times, NPR, the Guardian,
the Wall Street Journal, and the Washington Post, among others. Those pieces
cite the reports rather than the individual researchers.

The Children at Risk analysis of human trafficking near Texas schools was
picked up by the Dallas Morning News and the Fort Worth Star-Telegram in
addition to the Houston Chronicle piece listed above.
